items.headline: TurboQuant for weights: near‑optimal 4‑bit LLM quantization with lossless 8‑bit residual – 3.2× memory savings
items.summary: an adaptation of the recent TurboQuant algorithm (Zandieh et al., 2025) from KV‑cache quantization to model weight compression. It gives you a drop‑in replacement for nn.Linear with near‑optimal distortion. items.headline: [R] Controlled experiment: giving an LLM agent access to CS papers during automated hyperparameter search improves results by 3.2%
items.summary: Ran a controlled experiment measuring whether LLM coding agents benefit from access to research literature during automated experimentation. Setup: Two identical runs using Karpathy's autoresearch framework. Claude Code agent optimizing a ~7M param GPT-2 on TinyStories. M4 Pro, 100 experiments each, same seed config. Only variable — one agent had access to an MCP server that does full-text search over 2M+ CS papers and returns synthesized methods with citations. Results:    Without papers
